name: Cheval Blanc Paris
positioning: Cheval Blanc's Paris hotel inside La Samaritaine, Henri Sauvage's 1928 Art Deco building, facing the Pont-Neuf between the Louvre and Le Marais
best_for: Travelers who want Seine views in historic central Paris, a short walk from the Louvre
Spa lovers drawn to the Dior Spa, its Peter Marino-designed pool and hammam
Families using the complimentary Le Carrousel kids club

facts.text: Cheval Blanc Paris is in the heart of historic Paris, in front of the Pont-Neuf, between the Louvre and Le Marais.
Notre Dame is a 15-minute walk away and the Louvre is 5 minutes from the front door.
The hotel sits within La Samaritaine, Henri Sauvage's 1928 Art Deco building and a designated historic site.
This section of La Samaritaine was restored and reworked into a hotel over five years, opening in fall 2021.
In 2026, France's Ministry of Tourism awarded Cheval Blanc Paris the Palace distinction.
Architect Peter Marino reworked the interiors, his first hotel project.
The art in the shared spaces includes a Frank Gehry horse sculpture specially commissioned for the hotel.
Guests have a dedicated butler during their stay.
The bathroom amenities line was commissioned from Francois Demachy, Christian Dior's longtime in-house perfumer.
The spa floor also has a 24/7 gym and a Rossano Ferretti hair salon.
Chef Arnaud Donckele and pastry chef Maxime Frederic lead the restaurants Plenitude, Hakuba and Le Tout-Paris.
The complimentary Le Carrousel kids club offers daily activities for guests up to age 12.

highlights.text: The Dior Spa pool was designed by Peter Marino, set under a mirrored ceiling and surrounded by handcrafted mosaics by Michael Mayer.
The spa has six Dior treatment suites, a marble-clad hammam, a sauna, a cold plunge and a snow shower.
More than half of the rooms and suites have views of the River Seine; others look out at Parisian facades or the Louvre.
Guests can take a boat cruise on the Seine in a Cheval Blanc-chartered boat, accompanied by hotel staff with snacks, sweet treats and bubbles.
L'Appartement, on the 8th and 9th floors, has its own swimming pool, seven bedrooms and a panoramic terrace.

considerations.text: The hotel, its restaurants and the Dior Spa are accessible to people with reduced mobility.
WhataHotel notes ultra-premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the hotel's intimate size means availability can be limited.
